# Kotoba

> Hands-free Japanese vocabulary for your commute.

Kotoba is a voice-driven Japanese vocabulary app built for AirPods and car audio. It teaches a word, you say it back, and quizzes you later — all by voice. Spaced repetition schedules reviews right before you'd forget them.

## Features

- Voice-driven learning: listen, repeat, get quizzed — no screen required
- Spaced repetition (SRS) scheduling
- Curated JLPT N5 and N4 vocabulary decks
- Works offline as a Progressive Web App (PWA)
- Optional cloud sync to save progress across devices

## Links

- App: https://kotobaapp.com
